title: First love, now hate. This box is eeeevil
text: First love, now hate. This box is eeeevil. At first, I loved it. Simple, clear, displays the valuable gems of nespresso nicely. Then over time I started to notice something. The lid matches the box too perfectly. There is no overhang to grasp. No handle. It's morning, I'm tired, and this box is keeping me from my caffeine as I fumble to get a fingernail in to get it open. It's showing me my precious little capsules, just out of reach. Devilbox. Don't get between me and my nespresso. I hate you now.

product_metadata.title: Nespresso Cube Plexiglass Capsule Pod Holder with Recipe eBook! Holds 50 Capsules, Storage Solution for Nespresso Machines, Clear Dispenser
